subject: Re: travel delay
text: Hi Professor, thanks for the update, and I'm sorry the storm kept you from catching the earlier train. Honestly, don't try to force a meeting if the connection is already uncertain. I'd let the department know you'll join as soon as you can, then keep checking the station alerts from time to time rather than refreshing constantly. If the train gets cancelled outright, calling the operator directly tends to work faster than using the app, and you may be able to switch routes without waiting in line. Hope you're somewhere dry and not too stressed today either.
